name: Disbandment Approval
description: One of the approvals required for a disbandment. The row records who must approve; the decision itself is a Core Approval Decision, so that delegation, exception authorisation and the semantic open flag are the same machinery the rest of the platform uses. The mirrored decision label here is for display and is never compared.

fields.label: Approver Role
fields.options:
Delegating Authority
Sponsor
Chair
Jurisdictional CRO

fields.label: Required
fields.description: A jurisdictional CRO approval applies only where one applies.

fields.label: Approval Decision
fields.description: The Core record carrying the decision, the acting delegation and any exception authorisation.

fields.label: Decision
fields.description: Mirrored from the Approval Decision for display. Logic reads the Core record's semantic open flag, never this label.
